description: The SSE reader of the Hub (lib/sse.mjs) and the Responses stream that is read through it: every rule of the format, the limits, and the codes the Responses callers know.

mutations.name: SS1
mutations.what: an event is never handed to the caller at its blank line

mutations.name: SS2
mutations.what: the data lines of one event are joined with a space instead of a line feed

mutations.name: SS3
mutations.what: an event with no name is called something other than message

mutations.name: SS4
mutations.what: a comment line (a keep-alive) is read as a field
mutations.equivalent: a line that starts with a colon would otherwise be read as a field with an empty name, which is no field the Hub uses and is ignored like any unknown one: the comment rule is stated, not needed

mutations.name: SS5
mutations.what: every space after the colon of a field is dropped, not one

mutations.name: SS6
mutations.what: the space after the colon of a field is kept

mutations.name: SS7
mutations.what: the name of an event is still there for the next one

mutations.name: SS8
mutations.what: the data of an event is still there for the next one

mutations.name: SS9
mutations.what: the id field is not read

mutations.name: SS10
mutations.what: a byte order mark at the start of the stream is not skipped

mutations.name: SS11
mutations.what: the LF of a CRLF ends a line of its own

mutations.name: SS12
mutations.what: a lone CR does not end a line

mutations.name: SS13
mutations.what: a CR is not remembered, so the LF after it ends a second line

mutations.name: SS14
mutations.what: an ordinary character does not cancel the CR before it, so a later LF is swallowed

mutations.name: SS15
mutations.what: the last line of a stream with no line end is lost

patches.old: if (line !== '') finishLine(); // a last line with no line end
patches.new: // a last line with no line end

mutations.name: SS16
mutations.what: the last event of a stream with no blank line after it is lost

patches.old: finishLine(); // a last event with no blank line
patches.new: // a last event with no blank line

mutations.name: SS17
mutations.what: the event field is not read

mutations.name: SS18
mutations.what: a line with no colon takes its whole text as the value of its field

mutations.name: SS19
mutations.what: a byte order mark is skipped at the start of every chunk, not of the stream

mutations.name: SS20
mutations.what: the name of a field with no colon loses its last letter

patches.old: const field = colon === -1 ? text : text.slice(0, colon);

mutations.name: SR1
mutations.what: a body that is not a stream is read as one

mutations.name: SR2
mutations.what: a signal that has already aborted does not stop the read

mutations.name: SR3
mutations.what: a chunk that ends inside a UTF-8 character is decoded as it stands

mutations.name: SR4
mutations.what: the decoder is not flushed at the end of the stream
mutations.equivalent: only a stream that ends inside a character has bytes left in the decoder; for it the flush adds a replacement character to a line that is not an event anyway

mutations.name: SR5
mutations.what: the parser is not told that the stream is over

mutations.name: SR6
mutations.what: the events made by the end of the stream are not delivered

patches.old: await deliver(); // the events of the end of the stream
patches.new: // the events of the end of the stream

mutations.name: SR7
mutations.what: events wait for the end of the stream before they are delivered

patches.old: await deliver(); // the events of this chunk, before the next chunk is read
patches.new: // the events of this chunk, before the next chunk is read

mutations.name: SR10
mutations.what: a stop that comes while the events of the end of the stream are delivered is ignored

patches.old: if (stopped) throw stopped; // a stop, from wherever it came, is an error and not an end
patches.new: // a stop, from wherever it came, is an error and not an end

mutations.name: SR11
mutations.what: the byte cap is not enforced

mutations.name: SR12
mutations.what: the bytes of a chunk are not counted

mutations.name: SR13
mutations.what: the caller is not told that bytes arrived

mutations.name: SR14
mutations.what: the idle clock is not started again by the bytes that arrive

patches.old: watch(); // every byte starts the clock again
patches.new: // every byte starts the clock again

mutations.name: SR15
mutations.what: the idle clock does not run until the first byte has come

patches.old: watch(); // the clock starts with the read
patches.new: // the clock starts with the read

mutations.name: SR16
mutations.what: the idle clock is armed when the caller asked for none

mutations.name: SR17
mutations.what: the idle clock never runs

mutations.name: SR18
mutations.what: the error the caller chose for a silence is not used

mutations.name: SR19
mutations.what: an abort of the signal does not stop the read

mutations.name: SR20
mutations.what: an abort is reported without the reason of the signal

mutations.name: SR21
mutations.what: a stop does not cancel the stream, so a read that waits for a silent server waits for ever

mutations.name: SR22
mutations.what: the first reason for stopping is replaced by a later one

patches.old: if (stopped) return; // the first reason stands

mutations.name: SR23
mutations.what: events are still delivered after the read was stopped

mutations.name: SR24
mutations.what: events are delivered in reverse order

patches.old: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; }
patches.new: if (await onEvent(queue.pop()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; }

mutations.name: SR25
mutations.what: an error in the handler is swallowed

patches.old: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; }
patches.new: try { if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; } } catch { /* swallowed */ }

mutations.name: SR26
mutations.what: the error of a body that was aborted replaces the reason of the abort

mutations.name: SR27
mutations.what: the listener on the signal is left behind

mutations.name: SR28
mutations.what: the idle timer of a finished read is left running

patches.old: clearTimeout(idleTimer); // a finished read leaves no timer behind
patches.new: // a finished read leaves no timer behind

mutations.name: SR29
mutations.what: the stream is not cancelled when the read is over (a handler ended it with SSE_STOP and the server keeps the connection open)

patches.old: try { await reader.cancel(); } catch { /* already closed or failed */ }

mutations.name: SR30
mutations.what: the reader is not released when the read is over
mutations.equivalent: the body is not used again by anyone: the lock has no observable effect

patches.old: try { reader.releaseLock(); } catch { /* a read is still pending */ }

mutations.name: SW1
mutations.what: the [DONE] marker after the end of a Responses stream is read as JSON

mutations.name: SW2
mutations.what: a Responses event that is JSON but not an object is not refused

mutations.name: SW3
mutations.what: an oversized Responses stream is reported with the code of the reader

mutations.name: SW4
mutations.what: two terminal events in a Responses stream are accepted

mutations.name: SW5
mutations.what: a Responses stream with no terminal event is accepted

patches.old: if(!terminal)throw fail('responses_stream_interrupted','Responses stream ended without terminal confirmation. No tool calls executed.');

mutations.name: SW6
mutations.what: the text handler of a Responses stream is not waited for

mutations.name: SW7
mutations.what: the idle clock of the caller is not told that bytes arrived on a Responses stream

mutations.name: SW8
mutations.what: a cancel of the caller does not reach a Responses stream that is being read

mutations.name: SW9
mutations.what: an event of a Responses stream that is not JSON escapes without the code the callers know

mutations.name: SW10
mutations.what: a body that is not a stream is refused with the code of the reader, not the Responses one

patches.old: if(!body||typeof body.getReader!=='function')throw fail('invalid_responses_stream','Provider returned no SSE stream.');

mutations.name: SH1
mutations.what: a handler cannot end the read: SSE_STOP is ignored

patches.old: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; }
patches.new: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === Symbol('never')) { halted = true; return; }

mutations.name: SH2
mutations.what: any value a handler returns ends the read

patches.old: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) === SSE_STOP) { halted = true; return; }
patches.new: if (await onEvent(queue.shift()) !== undefined) { halted = true; return; }

mutations.name: SH3
mutations.what: the read goes on after a handler ended it

patches.old: if (halted) break; // a handler said the stream is over
patches.new: // a handler said the stream is over

mutations.name: SH4
mutations.what: the events made by the end of the stream are delivered after a handler ended the read

mutations.name: SH5
mutations.what: the result does not say that a handler ended the read
